vision.title: Low-quality or scanned pages were re-read with Gemini vision

reanalyze.body: Existing topics and draft questions will be deleted and the AI analysis will run again (approved questions stay in the database). Continue?

subject.title: 1. Assign the subject
subject.hint: All questions from this book will appear under this subject in the mobile app

topics.title: 2. Topics and page boundaries
topics.hint: Questions are generated strictly from the text within this page range — check the boundaries with 👁 and confirm. "{{appTopic}}": sets which topic in the app a question goes under when it is added — if you leave it unset, a new topic named after the book topic is created automatically.
topics.empty: No topics found — you can add them manually
topics.autoOption: Auto: a new topic will be created

generation.title: 3. Question generation
generation.diffError: Enter a value greater than 0 for at least one difficulty level
generation.diffNormalized: Ratios are automatically normalized to 100%: easy {{easy}}% · medium {{medium}}% · hard {{hard}}%

job.batchRunning: Running in batch mode (50% cheaper) — results arrive all at once

drafts.title: 4. Add questions to the database
drafts.hint: Questions generated by AI first stay here as drafts and are not visible in the mobile app. Only the questions you add with "{{approve}}" are shown to students. Edit the ones under "{{review}}" and add them, or reject them.
drafts.bulkAddTopic: Add ready ones from this topic ({{ready}})

empty.pending: No questions left in this section — check another tab

toast.approved: ✓ Question added to the database — it will appear in the mobile app
toast.rejected: Question rejected — it will not be used anywhere

bulk.title: Bulk add to database
bulk.bodyBook_one: {{count}} ready question from the book (source verified, status "{{pending}}") will be added to the database and start appearing in the mobile app.
bulk.bodyBook_other: {{count}} ready questions from the book (source verified, status "{{pending}}") will be added to the database and start appearing in the mobile app.
bulk.bodyTopic_one: {{count}} ready question from this topic will be added to the database.
bulk.bodyTopic_other: {{count}} ready questions from this topic will be added to the database.
bulk.bodyTail: Questions under "{{review}}" will not be added — you will review them separately. Continue?

card.approvedBadge: ✓ Added to database — shown in the mobile app
card.rejectTitle: Question is unusable — do not use it
card.approveTitle: The question will be added to the database and appear in the mobile app
